assertion_analysis.would_fail_if: the new identity remained the Git reckon-only tree
legacy package-only identities no longer extracted the package
legacy package-only extraction unexpectedly included skills
a legacy image did not retain its old identity
the image resolver refused or the image import failed
the child process imported checkout_trust outside the materialized image
the resolver returned a script outside the materialized image
a skills-only commit left the code identity unchanged
an unrelated NOTES commit moved the code identity
the package-only refusal had another cause

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares an output to the same input supplied to the function under test; expected Git tree IDs, image paths, process status, and refusal text are independent observations.

findings.text: blocking: The report attributes the 21:22Z onset to the old package-only archive, but history-evidence.log checks only whether later candidates changed the resolver or materializer; it does not rule out their dispatch-path changes making the already broken resolver newly reachable, so the required triggering change is not established.

item_verdicts.diff: commits 2f752a0b and 0d447232 respectively change the paired-tree loader and its assertions, then add the six-line evidence fragment, with no other paths in the diff.
item_verdicts.done_when: prompt.txt:99 and manifest.md:baseline_suite/after_suite require the temporary-image resolver, identity changes, refusal, and no added importer failures; focused-final.log records 2 passed, negative-control.log records 1 failed, and the paired suite logs record 83 passed each.
item_verdicts.goal: prompt.txt:30 requires a reloaded process to find its versioned fleet script; checkout_trust.py:422 materializes a paired tree that the image resolver can search.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md reports two commits, focused and importer gates, mutation and lint logs; baseline-suite.log and after-suite.log independently end with 83 passed and EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.write_paths: prompt.txt:69-75 grants checkout_trust.py, follower_registration.py, the named test, and the evidence fragment; git diff from 1e44e252 to 0d447232 changes only those four paths.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_reloaded_process_finds_its_fleet_script.py:88-139 has independent Git identities, image paths, process exit states, and refusal text; negative-control.log shows the positive test fails when package-only extraction is reinstated.
justifications.evidence: focused-final.log and the suite receipts verify the runtime gate, but docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/a-reloaded-process-finds-its-fleet-script.html:3 does not rule out changes to the dispatch call path as the 21:22Z trigger.
justifications.fit: reckon/checkout_trust.py:238-440 extends the existing subprocess and archive idiom and reckon/crew/follower_registration.py:28-35 keeps the production stamp entry point.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/checkout_trust.py:422 extracts the paired tree and tests/test_a_reloaded_process_finds_its_fleet_script.py:101-106 confirms the resolver uses it, while the required historical trigger remains unproved in the evidence fragment.
justifications.reuse: capability search found committed_reckon_tree and _reckon_subtree in reckon/checkout_trust.py:214,329, and the new helpers extend those owners rather than adding a second reload mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 1e44e252..0d447232 touches only the four granted paths in prompt.txt:69-75 and the fragment describes the node's measured change.
